# Elusion RPG (ElusionRPG)

> Elusion RPG - also written ElusionRPG, or just Elusion - is a free top-down pixel-art action RPG, made in Godot by Robert A. Clear (Tunacan, Tunacancode) of Elusion Studios, with co-owner AllMind. It is played free in a web browser on a PC or a phone at https://play.elusionrpg.com, and its website is https://elusionrpg.com.

Four classes (warrior, mage, tank, healer), seven elemental bosses and the Crowned Beholder, parties and guilds, fishing, cooking, a smith, pets, player trading over a taxed economy, and minigames such as the Endless, a horde of thousands of slimes. The game talks to its own server (Python and Flask, with a live WebSocket server for other players), which keeps everything worth having: the player's game is treated as hostile, and every rule names the test that proves it.
